prompt: How many songs make up the complete Prabhat Samgiita collection?
explanation: Prabhat Samgiita comprises 5,018 songs composed by Shrii Shrii Anandamurti ji.

prompt: Who composed Prabhat Samgiita?
explanation: Shrii Shrii Anandamurti ji (Baba) composed all 5,018 Prabhat Samgiita songs.

prompt: When did the composition of Prabhat Samgiita begin?
explanation: The first Prabhat Samgiita songs were given on 14 September 1982.

prompt: What does “Prabhat Samgiita” broadly signify?
explanation: Prabhat Samgiita is the music of the crimson dawn — devotion, hope, and spiritual awakening.

prompt: On this app, what can you do with a song besides listening?

options.text: Read lyrics, meaning, and ask the AI companion

explanation: Prabhat Samgiita AI helps you listen, read, understand, practise, and ask grounded questions.

prompt: How many AI companion questions can a guest ask per day (approx.)?
explanation: Guests receive grounded answers first; deeper AI questions are limited to about 15 per day.

prompt: Which feature requires signing in?

options.text: Saving favourite songs to your playlist

explanation: Signed-in members can save songs, take quizzes, earn certificates, and receive higher AI limits.

prompt: Where can you read devotee stories and interviews in this app?
explanation: The Stories section indexes devotee experiences sourced from the official archive.

prompt: Prabhat Samgiita songs express devotion together with which themes?
explanation: The songs weave devotion with nature, mysticism, humanism, and collective welfare.

prompt: What is the passing score for a Prabhat Samgiita AI quiz?
explanation: You need at least 7 correct answers out of 10 (70%) to earn your level certificate.

prompt: Which official site is the primary source for verified lyrics on this app?
explanation: Canonical lyrics and translations are indexed from prabhatasamgiita.net.

prompt: When did the composition period of Prabhat Samgiita end?
explanation: The last songs were given on 20 October 1990, completing the 5,018-song collection.

prompt: On 2 January 1983, Baba described Prabhat Samgiita as written with the ink of what?
explanation: Baba said Prabhat Samgiita is the feeling and expression of the heart, written with the ink of the heart.

prompt: Which devotee story in our archive is explicitly linked to song 419?

options.text: Avt. Ananda Karuna Ac. on “Kende Kende Kata D'a'ki”

explanation: The Ananda Karuna story is indexed alongside song 419 in the Stories collection.

prompt: What does “Akhanda Prabhat Samgiit” refer to?

options.text: Unbroken collective singing of Prabhat Samgiita

explanation: Akhanda singing is continuous, collective immersion in Prabhat Samgiita.

prompt: Ac. Shambhushivananda Avt. contributed which resource type in the official stories index?

options.text: 70 Questions and Answers on Prabhata Samgiita

explanation: His Q&A guide helps devotees understand history, practice, and meaning.

prompt: When the AI companion gives a “line-by-line” answer, what is it grounded in?

options.text: Canonical lyrics paired with verified meaning text

explanation: Structured answers pair each lyric line with the catalog meaning before any deeper AI is used.

prompt: Prashanta Das (later Ac. Priyashivananda Avt.) is especially remembered for what role?

options.text: Receiving and recording new Prabhat Samgiita from Baba

explanation: His interviews and stories describe the sacred process of receiving songs in Baba's room.

prompt: Which practice coach feature helps you learn melody on this app?
explanation: Where verified notation exists, the harmonium practice section supports learning the song.

prompt: Signed-in members receive roughly how many deeper AI questions per day?
explanation: Members receive a higher daily quota than guests while keeping usage cost-conscious.

prompt: Ac. Chandranath's story focuses mainly on which aspect of Prabhat Samgiit?

options.text: Language, translation, meaning, and melody together

explanation: His reflection explains how language, meaning, and melody cooperate in each song.

prompt: What happens if you fail a quiz level?

options.text: You can retry with a new random set of 10 questions

explanation: Retries are always available; after submitting you see your answers compared with the correct ones.

prompt: Daily reflections on the home page draw primarily from which sources?

options.text: Source-verified books such as Ánanda Sútram

explanation: Reflection quotes require book provenance and verification status before rotation.

prompt: Which level must you pass before attempting “Experienced” in the quiz journey?

options.text: No strict lock — choose any level, but Starter → Intermediate → Experienced is the suggested path

explanation: All three levels are open to signed-in members; progression is suggested for learning, not enforced.

prompt: In the official giving procedure described by Prashanta Das, how many persons should be present when Baba gives a new song?
explanation: According to his account, Baba's rule was that three persons should be present when a new song is given.

prompt: Kalyan Deva's indexed story title quotes Baba on Prabhat Samgiita being written with the ink of what?
explanation: Kalyan Deva's story centres on Baba's heart-centred description of the songs.

prompt: Ac. Priyashivananda Avt. wrote about which effect of Prabhat Samgiita besides “Complete Surrender”?

options.text: Replacing all medicine with silence only

explanation: His story on therapeutic effects discusses calm and restoration through singing and listening.

prompt: Which AI answer types are handled without using the daily deeper-AI quota?

options.text: Line-by-line, overview, related songs, meditation, and stories when structured

explanation: The API serves grounded structured answers first; quota applies when LLM depth is needed.

prompt: Ac. Vijayananda Avt. contributed multiple stories including which symbolic title?
explanation: Among his indexed stories are A tour of India, Writer Composer and Poet, and The Magic Mirror.

prompt: What does the app's query guard primarily protect against?

options.text: Off-topic or abusive prompts outside Prabhat Samgiita scope

explanation: Guardrails keep the companion focused on songs, meanings, practice, and related spiritual context.

prompt: Gayatrii's indexed story recalls Baba saying which instrument-related instruction?

options.text: “You will bring the guitar. And you will sing.”

explanation: Her story is indexed under that memorable instruction about sharing Prabhat Samgiita through song.

prompt: When a member passes a quiz level, what identifier appears on their certificate?

options.text: A unique certificate code plus level name and date

explanation: Passing creates a sample certificate authorized by Prabhat Samgiita AI with a readable certificate code.

prompt: Ramesh's story emphasises that Prabhat Samgiita can be played on what?
explanation: His reflection highlights adaptability across instruments while keeping devotional spirit.

prompt: Which service selects today's recommended songs using festivals and humanitarian context?

options.text: Recommendation engine with reviewed festival and occasion catalog
Alphabetical sort of song titles only

explanation: Today's recommendations combine Ananda Marga observances, world days, and reviewed thematic lists.

prompt: Ac. Cidrupananda Avt.'s story is titled with which intimate phrase?
explanation: The story describes a song feeling personally addressed between singer and Beloved.

prompt: What is the recommended learning path through the three quiz levels?
explanation: Starter builds basics, Intermediate deepens practice and stories, Experienced covers richer context.
